description: A 32 bore x 100 stroke cylinder drives a 2 kg sled. Press Valve to extend or retract. Watch the chamber pressures; change the flow controls, cushions, supply and load in Settings. You can also push the sled by hand against the air.
notes: Lumped air model: two chambers with a polytropic gas law, ISO 6358 flow through valve, tubes, flow controls and cushions. Datasheet C and b values give stroke times within roughly 10-20 %. Tune them to one measured stroke for better.
